why_receptor_is_null: Recirculation from a neighbour is NOT MODELLED at this facility: there is no other tagged data centre inside the solver's 600 m validated range, so the quantity the rise table computes -- the rise at a NEIGHBOUR'S intake -- does not exist here rather than being unmeasured. This is a statement about the model's domain, NOT a claim that recirculation here is zero. Self-recirculation (a building's own exhaust re-entering its own intake) is not modelled at ANY site in this project, including the three shipped ones.
